articles.summary: By Lauren Said-Moorhouse, for CNN October 9, 2013 -- Updated 1039 GMT (1839 HKT) Social entrepreneur Edwin Broni-Mensah launched GiveMeTap -- a free water refill network in the UK. "For every bottle that we sell, we are able to help another person get access to clean drinking water," he says. STORY HIGHLIGHTS Edwin Bro
articles.title: How free water in Britain could help hydrate Africa
